sections.heading: Protect Your Products from Rodent Damage – by ITC India Pvt Ltd
paragraphs: Rodent attacks are a major cause of system failure and fire hazards in sectors like electrical, telecom, infrastructure, and automotive. At ITC India Pvt Ltd, we provide NABL-compliant Anti-Rodent Testing to assess the resistance of materials against rodent damage, ensuring your products are safe, reliable, and regulation-ready.

sections.heading: Automotive Component Evaluation
paragraphs: Unchecked rodent activity can result in equipment failure, short circuits, and costly breakdowns.
